<thought>Based on the exact mass (179.0946) the molecular formula is C10H13NO2. The ¹H NMR shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two sets of 2H ddd), a methoxy singlet (3H, 3.81 ppm), and two aliphatic triplets (2H each, J ≈ 7.4 Hz) consistent with a –CH2–CH2– chain attached to the aromatic ring and a carbonyl group. This fits the structure of para‑methoxy‑phenyl‑propionamide (4‑methoxy‑phenyl‑propionamide). The corresponding SMILES is **COc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)N**.</thought>
<final_answer>COc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)N</final_answer>
